jobs.employer_name: Boehringer Ingelheim Pharma GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description:
Boehringer Ingelheim is a biopharmaceutical company active in both human and animal health. As one of the industry's top investors in research and development, the company focuses on developing innovative therapies that can improve and extend lives in areas of high unmet medical need. Independent since its foundation in 1885, Boehringer takes a long-term perspective, embedding sustainability along the entire value chain. Our approximately 54,500 employees serve over 130 markets to build a healthier and more sustainable tomorrow. Learn more at www.boehringer-ingelheim.com
The Position
Are you a business-oriented consultant, facilitator, and trainer who can translate strategic needs into impactful Data & AI upskilling initiatives? Join the Data X Academy, where you will help employees, business functions, managers, and leaders strengthen their ability to understand, adopt, and apply Data & AI in practical business contexts.
In this role, your contribution is not developing machine learning models or AI use cases.  Instead, you will design and deliver learning experiences, support business-focused Data & AI adoption, work closely with Data Scientists and subject matter experts, and help translate technical expertise into practical enablement for business audiences. You will connect business understanding, training delivery, stakeholder engagement, agile ways of working, and change enablement to create measurable learning and adoption impact.
The Data X Academy is Boehringer Ingelheim's global capability-building partner for Data & AI. We help people, teams, and leaders understand, apply, build, and lead with Data & AI, responsibly and with a clear connection to business value.
This position can be filled in Ingelheim.
This position has a hybrid setup with approximately 2-3 days per week on site.
Requirements

- Master's degree in Business Informatics, Information Technology, Learning & Development, Organizational Development, Economics, Natural Sciences, Business Administration (or a related field) or a bachelor's degree with more relevant professional experience is also
- Several years of professional experience in business consulting, business partnering, capability building, learning design, change management, or related functions.
- Proven ability to design and facilitate engaging trainings, workshops, learning journeys, and enablement programs for diverse stakeholder groups.
- Strong stakeholder management, consulting, communication, and facilitation skills, with the ability to translate business needs and complex topics into practical, business-oriented solutions.
- Experience working in complex, cross-functional environments, applying agile ways of working and driving organizational transformation, capability building, and Data & AI adoption
- Experience in Learning & Development, adult education, instructional design, or enterprise-wide capability building initiatives as well as in in change management, stakeholder engagement, community building, innovation management, and Data & AI adoption support is desirable
- Experience or certification in innovation, transformation, coaching, and organizational development methodologies (e.g., Design Thinking, Systems Thinking, Strategic Foresight, OKRs, Holacracy, or systemic/agile coaching) is an advantage
- Fluent English required, German language skills are a plus

As part of our commitment to transparency and fairness, salary information will be shared during the recruitment process. We also offer a comprehensive benefits and wellbeing package.
Applications from persons with severe disabilities are warmly welcomed. In cases of equal qualifications, such applicants will be given preferential consideration in the selection process.
With us, you can develop your own path in a company with a culture that knows our differences are our strengths - and break new ground in the drive to make millions of lives better.

Here, your development is our priority. Supporting you to build a career as part of a workplace that is independent, authentic and bold, while tackling challenging work in a respectful and friendly environment where everyone is valued and welcomed.

Alongside, you have access to programs and groups that ensure your health and wellbeing are looked after - as we make major investments to drive global accessibility to healthcare. By being part of a team that is constantly innovating, you'll be helping to transform lives for generations.

Want to learn more? Visit https://www.boehringer-ingelheim.com

Ready to contact us?
If you have any questions about the job posting or process - please contact our HR Direct Team, Tel: +49 (0) 6132 77-3330 or via mail: hr.de@boehringer-ingelheim.com
Recruitment process:
Step 1: Online application - The job posting is presumably online until September 10th, 2026. We reserve the right to take the posting offline beforehand.
Step 2: Virtual meeting until end of September
Step 3: On-site interviews beginning end of September / beginning of October
Please submit your application documents in English.

Saarland University is a campus university with an international reputation for research excellence, particularly in computer science and in the life sciences and nanosciences. The university is also distinguished by its close ties to France and its strong European focus. Around 17,000 students, studying over one hundred different academic disciplines, are currently enrolled at Saarland University. Saarland University is officially recognized as one of Germany’s family-friendly higher-education institutions and with a combined workforce of more than 4000 it is one of the largest employers in the region.

The Centre for Language, Cognition and Computation (CLaCC) is inviting applications for the following position commencing the earliest possible time.

Academic research assistant (m/f/x)

Reference number W2904, salary in accordance with the German TV-L salary scale1, pay grade: E13 TV- L, duration of employment: until 31.12.2028, volume of employment: 100 % of standard working time.

Workplace/Department:

Text+ is a collaborative project funded under the National Research Data Infrastructure (NFDI; text-plus.org/). As part of Text+, you will be part of a geographically distributed network of research groups, focusing on the integration of large language models (LLMs) into data preparation and analysis in the field of Digital Humanities (DH). At Saarland University, you will be based at the Centre for Language, Cognition and Computation (ClaCC) and be part of Prof. E. Teich’s research group within the Department of Language Science and Technology (LST; www.uni-saarland.de/fachrichtung/lst.html).

Job requirements and responsibilities:

• Application and comparison of language models for specific digital humanities tasks (e.g. text annotation)

• Adaptation of language models to different registers/text types

• Evaluation of language models with regard to bias

• Development of LM-based processing pipelines for users in the humanities

• Publication record in relevant areas

Your academic qualifications:

• Completed university studies in computational linguistics, digital humanities or computer science

• Language skills (according to GER): Fluent in spoken and written German and English (C1)

The successful candidate will also be expected to:

• Have excellent knowledge of how to use large language models, particularly in the field of digital humanities

• Have solid programming skills, particularly in Python

• Have experience with relevant platforms, e.g. PyTorch, spaCy

• Have teamwork skills

•Language skills (according to GER): The working language of the Text+ Consortium is German, so a very good command of German is required. In addition, a very good command of English (C1) is required.

What we can offer you:

• A flexible work schedule allowing you to balance work and family, among other things the possibility of teleworking

• Secure and future-oriented employment with attractive conditions

• A broad range of further education and professional development programmes (for example language courses)

• An occupational health management model with numerous attractive options, such as our university sports programme

• Supplementary pension scheme (RZVK)

• Discounted tickets on local public transport services (‘Job-Ticket‘ of the saarVV)

We look forward to receiving your meaningful online application (in a PDF file) by 04.09.2026 to clacc@uni-saarland.de Please include the reference number W2904 in the subject line of the e-mail.

If you have any questions, please contact us for assistance. Your contact:

Frau Prof. Dr. Elke Teich.

FR LST, UdS campus, clacc@uni-saarland.de

Pay grade classification is based on the particular details of the position held and the extent to which the applicant meets the requirements of the pay grade within the TV-L salary scale. Part-time employment is generally possible.

If you have obtained a foreign university degree, a proof of the equivalence of this degree with a German degree by the Zentralstelle für ausländisches Bildungswesen (ZAB) is needed before hiring. If necessary, please apply for this in time. You can find more information at https://www.kmk.org/zeugnisbewertung.

Unfortunately, neither costs for attending an interview at Saarland University nor costs for any certificate evaluation by the ZAB can be reimbursed in principle.

In accordance with its policy of increasing the proportion of women, the University actively encourages applications from women. Applications from severely disabled persons will be given preferential consideration in the event of equal suitability.

jobs.occupation: PhD Student in Computational Chemistry (f/m/d) (Pay scale 13 TV-L, 67 %) (Chemiker/in)
jobs.description:
We are a young, innovative university in the middle of the Metropole Ruhr. Excellent in research and teaching, we think in terms of possibilities instead of limits and develop ideas with a future. We live diversity, promote potential and are committed to educational equity.
The University of Duisburg-Essen invites applications for the position of a
PhD Student in Computational Chemistry (f/m/d) (Pay scale 13 TV-L, 67 %) (gross 38.265 – 54.388 €)
at the Faculty of Chemistry, Institute for Physical Chemistry (located at the campus in Essen).
The Faculty of Chemistry at the UDE is one of the largest chemistry faculties in Germany and offers three study programs under one roof: Chemistry, Water Science and Chemistry Teachers College. The young and dynamic research group led by Prof. Dr. Erna K. Wieduwilt focuses on elucidating the structures and reactions of transition-metal enzymes with computer simulations, thereby bridging the fields of computational chemistry and quantum crystallography.

Your tasks

You will conduct research within the project “Boosting Enzymatic Plastic Recycling via Future Computing” as part of the NRW Return Programme of Prof. Dr. Erna K. Wieduwilt. The main focus of your position will be on evaluating quantum mechanics/molecular mechanics (QM/MM) calculations on metalloenzymes and exploring whether machine learning can be used for predictions of enzymatic reactions in biomass and plastic degradation. In these areas, you will closely collaborate with postdoctoral and PhD researchers who have experience in QM/MM calculations of metalloenzymes and machine learning. Additionally, you will contribute to supervising students, teaching activities, and administrative tasks, aligned with your transferable skill development.

Your profile

- By the time of appointment, you will have successfully completed your university studies in chemistry, biochemistry, cheminformatics, bioinformatics, biology, physics or a related field with a standard period of study of at least eight semesters (minimum 270 credit points or equivalent) and an average grade of at least ‘good’ (or equivalent)
- You are highly motivated to pursue research in sustainable chemistry and push the boundaries of computational biochemistry
- Ideally, you have first experience in QM calculations and their analysis. Experience with QM/MM or QM-cluster calculations on enzymes is desirable but not required; you are eager to learn these methods
- Previous experience in the use of machine learning and/or QM software packages, high-performance computing (HPC) clusters, and Linux operating systems will be considered an advantage
- You demonstrate scientific curiosity, take responsibility for your own work, and actively contribute to team-oriented, interdisciplinary, and international collaborations inside and outside the research group. Fluency in English (written and spoken) is essential
The position offers the opportunity for further scientific qualification.

We offer

- An interesting and responsible research position with broad opportunities for academic and personal growth, allowing you to take responsibility and establish valuable connections with academic and industrial collaborators locally as well as internationally
- A supportive and appreciative working atmosphere within a highly motivated, international and diverse research group. We look forward to welcoming and onboarding our new team member
- Fully funded participation in national and international workshops, summer schools, and conferences as well as dedicated presentation training
- Training in state-of-the-art computational methods and software (e.g., ORCA, AMBER) as well as access to significant HPC resources (e.g., the cluster AmplitUDE (https://escience-wissr.gitpages.uni-due.de/hpc-support/content/amplitUDE/amplitude_hardware.html) )
- Access to graduate courses, transferable skills training and the possibility to apply for the Water Graduate School (WGS (https://www.uni-due.de/zwu/wgs.php) )
- Family-friendly policies, including childcare support
- Advisory services for employees with family care responsibilities
- Possibility to enrol as a student, granting access to student housing, local public transport throughout Germany (Deutschlandsemesterticket (https://www.uni-due.de/faq-studium/semesterticket_en.php) ) and discounts at university canteens, museums, etc.
- Excellent public transport connections and free parking
- Access to attractive sports and health programs (university sports)
- The possibility of remote work
Starting date: 01.12.2026
Contract period: 36 months (3 years) with the possibility of extension
Working time: 67% of a full-time employment (part-time employment is possible)
Application deadline: 25.09.2026
Please submit your application (motivation letter, CV, diplomas, transcript of records with grades, at least two references) quoting reference 416-26 to: Prof. Dr. Erna K. Wieduwilt, Universität Duisburg-Essen, Fakultät für Chemie, Campus Essen, 45117 Essen. Please compile your application in a single PDF file and send it via email to applications.wieduwilt@uni-due.de.
Additional information about our research and group can be found at:
- About the project “Boosting Enzymatic Plastic Recycling via Future Computing”: https://www.uni-due.de/2025-12-08-professor-erna-wieduwilt-researches-plastic-recycling
- About the group: https://www.linkedin.com/posts/erna-wieduwilt_scienceisteamwork-chemistry-mint-activity-7482096217875857408-1d_R?utm_source=share&utm_medium=member_desk-top&rcm=ACoAADDOYrUBY5t0a3GvPalmhq6zjRkeWRjRhdk (https://www.linkedin.com/posts/erna-wieduwilt_scienceisteamwork-chemistry-mint-activity-7482096217875857408-1d_R?utm_source=share&utm_medium=member_desk-top&rcm=ACoAADDOYrUBY5t0a3GvPalmhq6zjRkeWRjRhdk)
- Current webpage: https://www.uni-due.de/zmb/members/erna-wieduwilt.php
The University of Duisburg-Essen is committed to promoting diversity among its members (see https://www.uni-due.de/diversity/en/). It aims to increase the number of women in academic positions and therefore explicitly encourages qualified women to apply. Women will be given preference in accordance with the North Rhine-Westphalia State Equality Act (Landesgleichstellungsgesetz NRW) if they have equivalent qualifications. Applications from suitable severely disabled persons and persons of equal status within the meaning of Section 2 (3) SGB IX are welcome.

jobs.employer_name: Boehringer Ingelheim Pharma GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description:
OUR COMPANY

At Boehringer Ingelheim we develop breakthrough therapies and innovative healthcare solutions in areas of unmet medical need for both humans and animals. As a family owned company, we focus on long-term performance. We believe that, if we have talented and ambitious people who are passionate about innovation, there is no limit to what we can achieve; after all, we started with just 28 people. Now, we are powered by 50,000 employees globally who nurture a diverse, collaborative and inclusive culture.
The Position
Join our dynamic team at Boehringer Ingelheim as a Customer Experience (CX) Head, TA. In this pivotal role, you will be the strategic linchpin, leveraging data to enrich decision-making and uncovering new business opportunities within the TA. Working in close collaboration with the TA Head and a standing member of the Brand Team, you will drive customer-centric initiatives for Human Pharma Germany. If you're passionate about shaping customer experiences and have a knack for strategic thinking, we'd love to hear from you.
Tasks & responsibilities

- As the primary point of contact, you will engage with the TA Head and Brand Team, acting as a strategic sparring partner.
- You will be responsible for converting strategic and high-level tactical features into smaller, actionable user stories.
- Strong capabilities for business case and LRR development by evaluating on-going operational requirement against existing resource and capabilities
- Integral analytical support for OL, ACV and LTF planning process and preparations on a strategic level
- Involvement in business cases and LRR development will be a key part of your role, as you evaluate ongoing operational requirements against existing resources and capabilities.
- Overall management and leadership of 4-6 direct reports (incl people development) for the functional areas related to Project Management, Training & Development, Customer Insights & Forecasting, and Sales Force Effectiveness.
- Establishing strategic and cooperative relationships with various functions within HP Business Operations and cross-functional teams will be a major part of your role.
- You will serve as a liaison between various functions and groups (Brand Team, HP Operations Group Heads and Squad Leads), influencing stakeholders to improve productivity, manage necessary changes, and support key business projects.
- Direct reporting line to Head of Human Pharma Operations, Human Pharma Germany.

Requirements

- Doctoral degree (e.g., PhD, MD) and/or a Master's degree (e.g., MBA, MSc) or diploma degree
- Possess experience in a leadership or people manager role, including in-depth knowledge of the German human pharmaceutical market
- Exhibit excellent relationship-building skills and conflict management with above-average oral, written, and presentation skills
- Demonstrate the ability to drive change, manage organizational transformations, and proactively implement innovation
- Have experience in Commercial (Sales and/or Marketing), Training, Business Analyst roles.
- Possess the ability to lead and steer different functions and can lead without authority within a TAs
- Be capable of simplifying complex topics and providing clear actionable next steps.
- Exhibit strength in being a solution-driven leader to address issues/challenges and lead the team to move forward together
- Possess strong people management skills - inspires and develops growth for team members

As part of our commitment to transparency and fairness, salary information will be shared during the recruitment process. We also offer a comprehensive benefits and wellbeing package.
Applications from persons with severe disabilities are warmly welcomed. In cases of equal qualifications, such applicants will be given preferential consideration in the selection process.
With us, you can develop your own path in a company with a culture that knows our differences are our strengths - and break new ground in the drive to make millions of lives better.

Here, your development is our priority. Supporting you to build a career as part of a workplace that is independent, authentic and bold, while tackling challenging work in a respectful and friendly environment where everyone is valued and welcomed.

Alongside, you have access to programs and groups that ensure your health and wellbeing are looked after - as we make major investments to drive global accessibility to healthcare. By being part of a team that is constantly innovating, you'll be helping to transform lives for generations.

Want to learn more? Visit https://www.boehringer-ingelheim.com

Ready to contact us?
If you have any questions about the job posting or process - please contact our HR Direct Team, Tel: +49 (0) 6132 77-3330 or via mail: hr.de@boehringer-ingelheim.com
Recruitment process:
Step 1: Online application - The job posting is presumably online until 18.09.2026. We reserve the right to take the posting offline beforehand. Applications up to 11.09.2026 are guaranteed to be considered.
Step 2: Virtual meeting in the period from mid of September
Step 3: On-site interviews beginning of October
Please submit your application documents in English.

Are you looking for an exciting opportunity to contribute to cutting-edge technology? At LIDROTEC, a dynamically growing company on its way to becoming an established industry player, you can do just that!

LIDROTEC has developed an innovative laser process for cutting microchips, which is used in the production of high-performance chips for smartphones, cars and medical technology. At our Bochum location, our experienced team is constantly working on improving industrial systems and advancing the technology. Are you ready to be part of this future?

Your mission:

- You will be responsible for day-to-day financial accounting and will ensure that our business transactions are recorded accurately and on time
- You will work with DATEV on a daily basis and handle the account assignment and booking of documents
- You will process incoming invoices and assist with the processing of our outgoing invoices
- You will handle accounts payable, accounts receivable, and bank accounting
- You’ll keep track of our open items and assist with payment processing
- You’ll help prepare and finalize monthly and annual financial statements
- You’ll work closely with our tax advisor and other external partners
- You’ll help further professionalize and automate our finance and accounting processes as the company grows

What you should bring to the team:

- A completed commercial apprenticeship, e.g., as a tax clerk, financial accountant, or similar, is a plus
- Professional experience in financial accounting
- Excellent knowledge of day-to-day bookkeeping
- Experience with DATEV
- Proficiency with MS Office and common finance tools
- A meticulous, structured, and reliable work style
- Enjoyment of taking on responsibility and driving projects forward independently
- Good communication skills in German and English and a pragmatic, hands-on mindset
- You feel at home in a dynamic startup environment and are eager to actively help build structures

Why join us?
Innovation, openness, and curiosity are at the heart of our culture — and we’re always looking for fresh perspectives.

As the leading company in the field of software solutions for healthcare, we operate in 19 countries and employ over 9,000 dedicated staff members. You will work in a dynamic and innovative environment full of opportunities. With your commitment and passion, you have the chance to make a sustainable difference.

CGM Leverages AI: We’re looking for people who feel the power of AI in the e-health environment, who want to help shape change, and who are driven by a curious passion to see how technology can make healthcare smarter, simpler, and better.

Together, we are shaping the healthcare system of the future. Become part of our mission and make a difference - for a world where knowledge saves lives!

Are you passionate about groundbreaking products? Do you have the talent to turn ideas into real, valuable solutions-while always keeping the bigger picture in mind? Then we’d love to meet you!

You take end-to-end accountability for a large, distributed engineering organization that owns our ambulatory SaaS solutions and the shared framework modules used across all AIS DE products.

You co-define and drive the strategic product-technology roadmap for our cloud-based ambulatory portfolio in close collaboration with the executive leadership team.

You ensure that healthcare regulatory requirements-including medical device regulations, audits, and compliance-are rigorously embedded into product development, delivery, and operations.

You lead senior leaders and cross-functional teams, continuously increasing scalability, quality, AI maturity, and innovation velocity across products and platforms.

You represent the domain internally and externally, build strong executive-level stakeholder relationships, and position CGM as a leading SaaS provider in the Health-IT market.

Long-standing leadership experience at Director / VP / CTO level in SaaS product development, ideally with responsibility for large, distributed engineering organizations and complex product portfolios.

Exceptional academic background with a completed university degree and excellent grades, preferably in computer science, medical informatics, engineering, or a comparable technical field.

Deep expertise in cloud architectures and SaaS platforms, including modern DevOps practices and reliability engineering; hands-on experience with healthcare regulations (medical devices, audits, certifications) is a strong advantage.

Proven track record of driving AI adoption in engineering organizations, ideally with first-hand familiarity of Claude Code or comparable agentic coding tools (agents, skills, and workflows) and experience shaping AI pipelines, harnesses, and context engineering at organizational scale.

Excellent English and very good German, a strategic and entrepreneurial mindset, strong execution focus, outstanding leadership and communication skills, and the ability to guide complex organizations through transformation while staying clearly aligned with our healthcare purpose.

Mobile work: Work flexibly on the move two days a week and on site three days a week.

Attractive locations: In addition to fully equipped workplaces, regular events such as summer parties and Christmas parties await you at our locations.

Development: Our in-house academy and our portfolio of external cooperation partners will support you in your further development.

Health: Health is a valuable asset for us. Our in-house canteen offers a selection of tasty and healthy dishes every day, and we welcome you to our fully equipped fitness center for weekly courses (online & offline).

More is always possible: The kindergarten on our CGM campus in Koblenz helps our employees to organize their working day even more flexibly. We also offer corporate benefits, the option of a job bike, a company pension scheme, and much more.

Diversity is part of CGM! We look forward to receiving your application regardles...

jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

Join our Compression Regional Service Sales within Siemens Energy TI Compression as a Client Manager supporting customers from the Oil & Gas, chemical and industrial sectors.

The Client Manager is the owner of the client relationship, and is responsible for ensuring customer satisfaction, meeting client requirements and driving Services bookings growth within their respective territory. He/she leads all aspects of business and opportunity development from the initial stages through order entry. 

This position is primarily focused on Germany (Western & Eastern part) market and reports to the Head of Sales REGION WE, SWE, NORDICS and GERMANY.

You will be involved in some of the most exciting and challenging service and modernization projects within these industries. This is a highly networked role that requires an ability to work under challenging deadlines. 

 

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Develop and manage long-term relationships with assigned clients
* Proactively and systematically prospect the market aiming to generate new leads and opportunities.
* Understand the evaluation and decision-making process of customers and develop a strategy to position Siemens Energy ahead of the competition. 
* Develop and execute the sales capture plan (annual plan) and strategy around each customer in your responsibilities, incorporating the customer needs, equipment application, Siemens Energy strengths, competitor’s weaknesses and a robust market level pricing recommendation based on the assessment of competitive position.
* Identify advanced business opportunities (LMU) and support RPDM in developing and successfully closing such opportunities.
* Identify, create and maintain a robust opportunity pipeline in Salesforce to support overall business sales target. Own the Sales target in the assigned territory. Effectively manage opportunities via CRM Tool (Salesforce.com), ensuring opportunities are regularly updated
* Maintain the accuracy (within SFDC) of the entire installed equipment population, including operating status and planned outages, and client data in the assigned territory
* Prepare, coordinate and conduct proposal negotiations until closure of the opportunities in cooperation with other involved professionals
* Conduct Win/Loss analyses and provide input to fighting guides and regional competitive analyses.
* Provide voice of the client needs/competitive intelligence, market drivers and buying influences for the development of new product and service offerings

What You Bring

* Proven track record in driving results, delivering on growth strategies and proactive creation & conversion of sales opportunities in complex market environments
* Bachelor of Science in Engineering required with a minimum 5 years of experience in Energy industry and at least 3 years in sales/business development role.
* Turbomachinery experience/knowledge is mandatory, strong technical understanding of industrial compressors is preferred.
* Ability to work independently and interact with all levels within customer organization, strong analytical and strategic problem solver with a focus on technical differentiation and value selling
* Proficient in communication, both written and spoken, be able to discuss technical and commercial aspects.
* Willingness to travel as required.(50% and more)
* Business German andd English speaking and writing skills are necessary.

About the Team

Our Transformation of Industry division is decarbonizing the industrial sector. Increasing electrification and efficiency are key and demand for green H2 and derivative fuels will rise. We enable decarbonization of the industrial sector and the transition to sustainable processes, building on a strong industrial customer base, a global network, diverse technologies, and integrated execution capabilities.

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

As Project Manager for DED Arc Additive Manufacturing Technology Development, you will drive the industrialization and future technological roadmap of wire arc additive manufacturing for the Steam Turbine & Generator (STG) business.Your primary focus will be the qualification of components and materials, combined with the advancement of DED Arc processes, supporting the transformation toward modern, flexible and digitally enabled manufacturing. 

You will strengthen the existing team by adding expertise in welding technology, materials science, design for additive manufacturing, quality management, automation, and standardization. In addition, you will build strategic research partnerships to accelerate innovation.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Lead development projects to advance DED‑Arc Additive Manufacturing for turbine and generator components
* Drive technology readiness (TRL) progression from lab development to industrial deployment
* Plan, execute, and document material qualification programs according to internal standards, customer requirements, and international norms
* Establish standardized qualification routes for parts with varying complexity and operational requirements
* Collaborate closely with laboratories, test facilities, certification bodies, and internal quality teams as well as act as a technical leader, promoting knowledge-sharing, modern working methods, and cross-disciplinary collaboration
* Build and maintain strong partnerships with universities, research institutes, technology suppliers, and collaborative networks

What You Bring

* Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Welding Engineering, Materials Science, Production Engineering, or equivalent technical field 
* Professional experience in Additive Manufacturing, preferably DED‑Arc/WAAM or comparable welding processes
* Strong understanding of materials behavior, welding metallurgy, automation, and qualification procedures 
* Very good knowledge in the field of project management and corresponding to several years of experience in interdisciplinary research and development projects
* Strong communication skills, proactive leadership style, and ability to work in interdisciplinary teams
* Passion for innovation and technology development
* Fluency in German and English (written and spoken)

About the Team

Our Transformation of Industry division is decarbonizing the industrial sector. Increasing electrification and efficiency are key and demand for green H2 and derivative fuels will rise. We enable decarbonization of the industrial sector and the transition to sustainable processes, building on a strong industrial customer base, a global network,diverse technologies, and integrated execution capabilities.

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity

OVERVIEW:

Fairtrade is the most recognized and trusted sustainability label, working to make trade fairer for people and planet.

For more than three decades, Fairtrade has been making an impact on the way trade works. We believe that every farmer and worker should have access to a better way of doing business, and a better way of living. 

 Fairtrade International is an independent non-profit organisation representing more than two million small-scale farmers and workers worldwide. It owns the FAIRTRADE Mark, a registered trademark that appears on more than 37,000 products. Beyond certification, Fairtrade International and its member organisations (three producer networks and 19 national Fairtrade organisations) partner with producers and businesses, engage consumers, and advocate for a fair and sustainable future.

PRINCIPAL ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

Objective/ purpose:

The HR Generalist runs the day-to-day HR tasks, especially in the area of recruitment and Learning & Development (L&D) and provides HR services to FI employees and Line Managers. Liaising closely with all HR colleagues, the HR Generalist ensures that HR processes are properly followed in a timely manner.

Responsibilities:
Independent and responsible conduction of the following tasks: 

- Coordinate L&D activities, including administration of FI’s e-learning platform, updating course content and driving platform improvements; schedule and track trainings, and manage external training providers.
- Assist with the implementation of skills management in the HR system.
- Support recruitment processes (e.g. preparing job ads, screening applicants, coordinating interviews and ensuring effective and timely communication on recruitment topics). 
- Support the execution of Onboarding and Offboarding processes of employees. Cooperate with other units, functions, and public authorities with regards to the onboarding and offboarding processes.
- Carry out administrative and organizational activities (e.g. working time & absence recording)
- Provide and coordinate regular and accurate HR Statistics & KPIs
- Support and substitute HR team members and undertake other tasks that are consistent with the level and responsibilities of this post.

SKILLS REQUIRED:

- University qualification or commercial apprenticeship with further qualification in relevant field such as Human Resources, Business Administration or comparable education. 
- 1-3 years of experience in recruitment and L&D
- In-depth understanding of HR functions and processes. 
- Good knowledge of German labour law and social security law, tariff regulation and works constitution law.
- Very good coordination and organizational skills.
- Very good communication skills and facility in cross-cultural communication.
- Fluent English and German oral and written.
- Diplomatic and sensitive approach.
- Solution-oriented team player.
- Good command of MS Office Suite and digital competence.
- High level of accuracy and attention to detail.
- Reliable, diligent and service driven working attitude.
- Motivation for Fairtrade.

TERMS AND CONDITIONS:

- This is a full-time position within Fairtrade International
- Location is at Fairtrade International offices in Bonn, Germany with the opportunity for hybrid work arrangements
- The office language is English.
- Salary as per the Collective Bargaining Agreement for the Wholesale and Foreign Trade Industries for North Rhine Westphalia Group V and over tariff payments (starting at 3,814.00 Euros gross per month)
- Holiday Bonus and 13th salary
- 30 days of holidays per year (for fulltime employees)
- Subsidised public transportation ticket
- Subsidised meal services
- Childcare cost subsidy 

Please note that Fairtrade International is strict in compliance with the required qualification criteria mentioned above, and only those candidates selected for interviews will be contacted.
